summary: Prudential plc furnished a Form 6-K carrying a UK TR-1 major holdings notification. UBS Group AG reported that its trading book holdings in Prudential fell below the 5% disclosable threshold on 14-Sep-2026, moving from a prior 5.1185% aggregate (5.0123% voting rights plus 0.1062% via financial instruments) to 0.0000% and zero shares, with the issuer notified 15-Sep-2026. The filing is a routine disclosure of a passive threshold crossing by a bank trading book, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated; watch for further TR-1 changes.
